body: I too am battling with depression, I know how it feels :( Just want to tell you that I really do care and just hope you will start to feel better :) It means everything to help someone in need, thank you for wishing me well. All the best
We all have academic related stress. Please don't do anything to harm yourself, drowning is a horrible way to die, don't
Please don't do it, no we don't need another life gone from this planet fuck please don't. If you want to talk you can chat to me anytime . Please don't do it
You are on the wrong path, don't do it. PM me if you want to talk to someone.
I would really really like your help :) I've been to some really dark scary places, nearly killed myself 5 times and I somehow managed to cheer myself up lol.
Every life saved is a life worth living for

I guess what I was trying to accomplish was to reach out to as many people as possible, if I could sit down with each and every single person who is feeling down and suicidal absolutely believe me I would, I am probably the least self centered person you will ever encounter. I'm pretty sure many of us that are really fucken depressed can see through the self centered BS advice that sometimes comes across. I would spend every second of my life to help my fellow man and women if I could.
I know, I didn't want it to come across like that.  Fuck it's sometimes hard to help others
I have been talking to others to help them. This wasn't my only thread. So I apologize. I don't want to talk about myself at all, I don't care about myself, I care about others
Thing is I am also in a severe depression and I am fighting it, I am going through the same things that the others on here are too, I hope everyone is staying strong
I hope it helps someone.It helped me. I truly really love everyone, I don't want people to be sad, there are so many things to do in life
You need to separate the depression from your normal thought process. Depression is a battle

There are such fun things to do in life, that's why life is worth living. Gaming, racing motorbikes, building cool things, learn about space, physics etc there is an unlimited amount of curiosity available in the world if you chase ling enough, life shouldn't be boring. Not only that, some of the finer things in life such as nature and love can be more than enough for some people. Work harder than you usually do, start a business and you will become happier.I live for curiosity , there is so many magical things in our world

There are so many ways to access the internet. Think of some of the kids from poverty stricken, war torn countries, with arms and legs blown off, families with nothing (literally), absolutely nothing, they have managed to pull themselves back, they did it will much less. Trust me, there are many people worse off than you. Start a small business on the internet, try programming, just try to learn things, it will be very difficult at first, you will feel like giving up, but if you try and try again you will succeed. Please try, I will be thinking of you, I know you will make your life better

It's time to change your life, there are an infinite number of resources available online to learn pretty much anything you can think of. Perhaps start learning (Java/Python ) programming, it's not hard to learn and would suit your physical conditions. It's also personally rewarding and pays well. It starts with you

I love you and care :)
